# Audit Finding

This folder captures specific audit findings and data discrepancies identified during the evaluation of quality indicators in the Danish IBD database. It details regional explanations for unmet targets, such as Region Hovedstaden's reports on patients who were fully examined by private practitioners or miscoded, providing crucial context for interpreting raw performance metrics.

## Pages

- [[audit-finding|Audit Finding]] — Documents specific audit discrepancies and regional explanations, such as miscoded patients and alternative colonoscopy completions affecting Indikator 1a.
